Coupled Technique(s).cell: ID-TIMS U-Pb on an Isotopx X-62 at MIT, and solution Q-ICP-MS (Agilent 7700) for Zr and Hf concentrations, on aliquots of the same dissolutions
Coupled Technique(s).value: ID-TIMS U-Pb on an Isotopx X-62 at MIT, and solution Q-ICP-MS (Agilent 7700) for Zr and Hf concentrations, on aliquots of the same dissolutions

Coupling Description.cell: Functional: 3 M HCl washes from the U-Pb anion chemistry were collected and became the Zr aliquots, so the same crystal yields a U-Pb date and a Zr isotopic composition. Sequence: U-Pb purification first, Zr purification from its washes
Coupling Description.value: Functional: 3 M HCl washes from the U-Pb anion chemistry were collected and became the Zr aliquots, so the same crystal yields a U-Pb date and a Zr isotopic composition. Sequence: U-Pb purification first, Zr purification from its washes

Target Material.cell: Single zircon and baddeleyite crystals, and bulk rock

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Single crystal — "Single zircon and baddeleyite crystals selected for analysis were individually handpicked"; each "individually loaded into clean PFA microcapsules"

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Crushing in a stainless steel mortar, sieving through 375 µm plastic mesh, washing in a plastic gold pan, hand magnet, Frantz LB-1 magnetic separation, methylene iodide heavy liquid, hand picking under high-purity ethanol
Sample Preparation Method.value: Crushing in a stainless steel mortar, sieving through 375 µm plastic mesh, washing in a plastic gold pan, hand magnet, Frantz LB-1 magnetic separation, methylene iodide heavy liquid, hand picking under high-purity ethanol

Digestion Acid(s).cell: 29 M HF; after conversion to a chloride matrix for U-Pb. Zr aliquots taken up in 3 M HNO3 + 0.5 M HF

Digestion Vessel Type.cell: "clean Teflon microcapsules" inside "a large-volume Parr digestion vessel"
Digestion Vessel Type.value: "clean Teflon microcapsules" inside "a large-volume Parr digestion vessel"

Digestion Step.cell: Untreated crystals, 1: 29 M HF in a PFA microcapsule inside a Parr vessel, 215 deg C, 48 h. Chemically abraded crystals (19 zircons), 1: 12-h partial dissolution in 29 M HF at 215 deg C under pressure, after annealing at 900 deg C for 60 h | 2: the same complete digestion. The annealing is a pre-treatment, not a digestion step.

value.member: 1: 29 M HF in a PFA microcapsule inside a Parr vessel
1: 12-h partial dissolution in 29 M HF at 215 deg C under pressure
after annealing at 900 deg C for 60 h | 2: the same complete digestion. The annealing is a pre-treatment

Digestion Duration.cell: 48 h at 215 deg C in a Parr vessel. The 60 h previously recorded here is the chemical-abrasion ANNEALING at 900 deg C, not a digestion; the abrasion leach itself is 12 h.

Final Solution Matrix.cell: 0.59 M HNO3 + 0.28 M HF, samples and bracketing standards matched in matrix and at 60 ng/g total Zr

Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.cell: Single crystals; ~50 µl (5% of sample) taken for concentration measurement
Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.value: Single crystals; ~50 µl (5% of sample) taken for concentration measurement

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: Yes — AG-1X for U-Pb; Ln-Spec (~300 µl, 25–50 µm) for Zr, giving >95% Zr, undetectable REEs and <3% of initial Hf; TODGA first stage for bulk rocks

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: In-house 91Zr-96Zr double spike, added at a 0.43:0.57 spike-to-sample Zr mass ratio
Isotope Dilution Spike.value: In-house 91Zr-96Zr double spike, added at a 0.43:0.57 spike-to-sample Zr mass ratio

Instrument Manufacturer.cell: Nu Instruments — "a Nu Plasma II MC-ICP-MS fitted with an enhanced sensitivity interface"

ICP-MS Type.cell: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]
ICP-MS Type.value: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]

Desolvation System.cell: Cetac Aridus II — "Analyses were conducted in dry plasma mode"

Data Processing Software(s).cell: Mathematica — "Data were reduced using a minimization approach implemented in Mathematica"

Plasma Thermal Mode.cell: Dry plasma — "Analyses were conducted in dry plasma mode using a Cetac Aridus II desolvator nebulizer"

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: Masses 90, 91, 92, 93, 94, 95, 96 and 98 — "Masses 90, 91, 92, 93, 94, 95, 96, and 98 were measured in static mode at 0.5 amu spacing in the Nu Plasma II collector block, allowing direct monitoring of all Zr isotopes and Mo interferences (masses 95 and 98)" (p.11). 95 and 98 carry the Mo monitors and serve no target species

Reported Variables and Units.cell: δ9x/90ZrNIST in permil — δ91/90Zr, δ92/90Zr, δ94/90Zr and δ96/90Zr

Collector Configuration.cell: Masses 90, 91, 92, 93, 94, 95, 96 and 98 "measured in static mode at 0.5 amu spacing in the Nu Plasma II collector block"

Baseline Measurement Approach.cell: "On-peak-zero correction was done using the mean acid blank intensities before data processing to account for blank contribution as well as any 'memory' effects from the Aridus II sample introduction system during the run"
Baseline Measurement Approach.value: "On-peak-zero correction was done using the mean acid blank intensities before data processing to account for blank contribution as well as any 'memory' effects from the Aridus II sample introduction system during the run"

Analysis Sequence.cell: "Each sample measurement was individually bracketed by measurements of the ZrNIST solution spiked at the same level as our samples and matched in concentration (60 ng/g) as well as acid matrix"; each measurement preceded by an acid blank
Analysis Sequence.value: "Each sample measurement was individually bracketed by measurements of the ZrNIST solution spiked at the same level as our samples and matched in concentration (60 ng/g) as well as acid matrix"; each measurement preceded by an acid blank

Internal Standard Element.cell: N/A — mass bias corrected by standard-sample bracketing, internal normalization or a double spike rather than by an added internal standard element

Internal Standard Concentration.cell: N/A — no added internal standard element

Mass Bias Correction Strategy.cell: 91Zr-96Zr double spike inversion, with ZrNIST bracketing after inversion
Mass Bias Correction Strategy.value: 91Zr-96Zr double spike inversion, with ZrNIST bracketing after inversion

Mass Fractionation Law.cell: Power-law form used in the double-spike inversion equation
Mass Fractionation Law.value: Power-law form used in the double-spike inversion equation

Double-Spike Mixing Ratio.cell: 0.43:0.57 spike-to-sample Zr mass ratio, described as optimal
Double-Spike Mixing Ratio.value: 0.43:0.57 spike-to-sample Zr mass ratio, described as optimal

Double-Spike Inversion Algorithm.cell: "a minimization approach implemented in Mathematica, taking into account all ratios (i.e., 91/90Zr, 92/90Zr, 94/90Zr, and 96/90Zr) with different weighs being assigned to each based on their associated uncertainty", cross-checked against two exact three-ratio solutions
Double-Spike Inversion Algorithm.value: "a minimization approach implemented in Mathematica, taking into account all ratios (i.e., 91/90Zr, 92/90Zr, 94/90Zr, and 96/90Zr) with different weighs being assigned to each based on their associated uncertainty", cross-checked against two exact three-ratio solutions

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: On-peak-zero correction using mean acid blank intensities
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: On-peak-zero correction using mean acid blank intensities

Interference Correction Method.cell: A doping calibration: "Offset δ94/90ZrNIST = −63.4 · x" where x is the total Mo/Zr atomic ratio; the reported data are uncorrected for residual Mo

value.value: "Offset δ94/90ZrNIST = −63.4 · x" where x is the total Mo/Zr atomic ratio

Isotope Dilution Data Reduction Method.cell: Double-spike inversion, Rmeas = [p·RSpike + (1−p)·RStd·(Mx/Mn)^α]·(Mx/Mi)^β, solved by weighted minimisation over four ratios
Isotope Dilution Data Reduction Method.value: Double-spike inversion, Rmeas = [p·RSpike + (1−p)·RStd·(Mx/Mn)^α]·(Mx/Mi)^β, solved by weighted minimisation over four ratios

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: On-peak-zero acid blank before each sample "to account for blank contribution as well as any 'memory' effects from the Aridus II sample introduction system during the run"
Memory Effect Mitigation.value: On-peak-zero acid blank before each sample "to account for blank contribution as well as any 'memory' effects from the Aridus II sample introduction system during the run"

Uncertainty Level.cell: "the external reproducibility (at 2σ) of the spiked ZrNIST measurements from each run, which in all cases was similar in magnitude or slightly larger than the internal uncertainty determined from counting statistics"
Uncertainty Level.value: "the external reproducibility (at 2σ) of the spiked ZrNIST measurements from each run, which in all cases was similar in magnitude or slightly larger than the internal uncertainty determined from counting statistics"

Uncertainty Propagation Method.cell: External reproducibility of the spiked ZrNIST measurements from each run adopted per determination, compared against internal counting-statistics uncertainty

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — Table 1 records "Number of times the same purified Zr solution was measured independently in the MC-ICP-MS" and "Reported values are weighted means of all replicate" analyses. No rejection rule stated

Combination Method.cell: all: weighted mean of all replicate measurements of each fraction — Table 1 note †: 'Reported values are weighted means of all replicate measurements for each fraction'

value.value: weighted mean of all replicate measurements of each fraction

Constants and Reference Values Used.cell: 238U/235U = 137.818 (45), 18O/16O = 0.00205 (44), and α = 0.18 ± 0.02%/amu from repeat NBS-981 analyses; U decay constants of (47); Th/U[magma] = 2.8 ± 1.0 for the initial 230Th disequilibrium correction
Constants and Reference Values Used.value: 238U/235U = 137.818 (45), 18O/16O = 0.00205 (44), and α = 0.18 ± 0.02%/amu from repeat NBS-981 analyses; U decay constants of (47); Th/U[magma] = 2.8 ± 1.0 for the initial 230Th disequilibrium correction

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: Every sample — "Each sample measurement was individually bracketed"

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property
Counting Statistics Error.cell: Internal uncertainty determined from counting statistics, used as the comparison against the external reproducibility adopted per determination; value not tabulated

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property
Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.cell: Internal uncertainty determined from counting statistics; stated to be similar in magnitude to or slightly smaller than the external reproducibility adopted per determination

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: External reproducibility at 2 sigma of the spiked ZrNIST measurements from each run, adopted as the uncertainty on each determination and stated to be similar to or slightly larger than the internal counting-statistics uncertainty

Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical P.cell: External reproducibility at 2σ of the spiked ZrNIST measurements from each run
